label: The meditator thinks: the meditator bears some occurring thought episode
paraphrase: The first-person cogito, analyst formulation (navigation: Descartes, Meditation II, 'I think'; attribution deferred): the designated meditator bears some occurring thought episode (ThinkingRootFork.Thinks at the meditator). Stronger than ThoughtOccurs (some thought episode occurs). It does not say that the meditator exists at a world, is concrete, is finite or is a substance.
